loop1_attract_sync.purpose: Attract Mode & Title Screen Frame Synchronization

historical_reconciliation:
Reconciliation Finding:
- Milestones M15.228 and earlier cited '0x008ACA..0x008B7A' as a single coarse range (4.86M steps).
- M15.238/M15.239/M15.240 performed exact PC-level instruction tracing, revealing that this workload consists of two distinct, sibling frame-wait loops:
  1. 0x008ACA..0x008AD0 (5,327,384 steps) during attract/title sequence.
  2. 0x008B72..0x008B7A (4,402,749 steps) during active gameplay.
- The sum of these two loops is exactly 9,730,133 steps (55.198% of total guest steps).
- The code between 0x008AD2 and 0x008B70 is non-idle frame dispatching logic and must not be classified as idle.
